section.44: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

44.name_native: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

hadiths.text: Urwa reported:'Aisha said to me: Your fathers (Zubair and Abu Bakr) were amongst those about whom (it has been revealed):" Those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon them
